title: 404 for invalid and pre-launch dates
summary: Invalid dates (/hra/nesmysl) and dates before launch now show the regular 404 page with HTTP status 404. A past date without a board would say "Pro tento den tabule není"; future dates keep "Tahle otázka ještě nevyšla".
tradeoffs: None of note; the 404 page has no countdown or statistics, unlike the current misleading page.
